description: This is a source file (Markdown documentation) describing the `ConsoleMessage` class from Playwright's API. It details how console messages are handled across various programming languages, including JavaScript, Java, Python, and C#. The content covers the class's purpose, methods, and example usage snippets demonstrating how to listen for and process console messages in different environments.

classes.name: ConsoleMessage
classes.description: Represents a console message dispatched by page events, encapsulating details like message text, arguments, type, location, and the associated page or worker.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.args
methods.description: Returns an array of JSHandle objects representing the arguments passed to the console function call.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.location
methods.description: Provides the location where the console message originated, either as an object (with URL, line number, column number) or as a formatted string.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.page
methods.description: Returns the page that produced the console message, if available.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.text
methods.description: Returns the text content of the console message.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.type
methods.description: Returns the type of the console message, such as 'log', 'error', 'warning', etc.

methods.name: ConsoleMessage.worker
methods.description: Returns the worker that produced the message, if applicable.
